page.layout: One photograph of a book spine lying on its side, with faint lettering written in ink on the spine (partly visible at left and right), and a digitiser's credit band below the image. No printed text block on this scan.
page.notes: The scan shows the spine of a bound volume, not a printed page. The only lettering is handwritten or stamped on the spine, partly legible at the left ("CA..." in vertical lettering) and at the right ("...CI..." in vertical lettering), and so is not transcribed. The black band at the bottom carries the digitiser's credit ("Early European Books, Copyright © 2012 ProQuest LLC. Images reproduced by courtesy of The Wellcome Trust, London. 4974/A"), which is excluded as digitiser furniture. No printed page text is present.
